author: 网易云音乐
quote_zh: 你住的城市下雨了，很想问你有没有带伞，可是我忍住了，因为我怕你说你没带而我又无能为力，就像我爱你却给不到你想要的陪伴。
quote_en: It's raining in the city where you live. I would like to ask if you have an umbrella, but I resisted because I was afraid that you said you didn't have one and I couldn't do anything about it, just like I love you but I can't give you the companionship you want.
